actions.text: Start a command with a JSON body: the command type is matched by the resource name, the body is deserialized into that command, and it is pushed to the command queue as a manual trigger.
Cancel a command by id, which removes it from the queue if it is still queued.

rules.text: The command type is the single known Command implementation whose class name, with "Command" removed, equals the requested name, ignoring case. Zero or multiple matches cause an error.
ManualImportCommand is queued with High priority. All other commands are queued with Normal priority.
SuppressMessages is set to the opposite of the submitted SendUpdatesToClient, and SendUpdatesToClient is then forced to true.
The command's ClientUserAgent is taken from the request's UserAgent header.
A command can be cancelled only when it is in the queue with status Queued. If it is not removed (including when no such command is found), a 409 Conflict error "Unable to cancel task" is raised.
For POST and PUT requests, resources are validated before the action runs. The id argument is validated when the action is marked for id validation and validation is not skipped.
Calls to endpoints marked deprecated are logged as a warning and get a "Deprecation: true" response header.

shows.text: Starting a command returns a created-at-action result pointing to the new command's resource, looked up by the tracked command's id.
Getting a command by id returns it as JSON, or Not Found when the model is not found.
Cancelling a command returns no body.

sideEffects.text: Starting a command adds it to the command queue as a manual-trigger command.
Cancelling a queued command removes it from the queue and wakes up waiting threads on the queue.
